title: Day 7: First Red Day – VPS Failure During Live Forward Test
author: _Mann_98
selftext:
Day 7 of the live forward test didn't go as planned.The loss wasn't due to a change in the trading logic but because of a VPS issue that interrupted the EA during execution. One thing I've learned from this is that the infrastructure behind an automated strategy is just as important as the strategy itself.

I'm leaving this update here because I want the forward test to be transparent. That means sharing the setbacks as well as the profitable days.

comments.author: Ok-Draft2744
comments.body: Not a bad way stay accountable. How long was the interruption if you don't mind sharing? Did you have a stop loss?
